Technical Summary:
Autonomous vehicles are self-driving cars that operate without human control. They work by using a mix of cameras, sensors, and smart computer programs (artificial intelligence) to "see" and understand the road. These systems constantly gather information about their surroundings to spot obstacles, read traffic lights, and make quick decisions. The main goals of this technology are to make driving safer for everyone and to help reduce traffic jams.
